title: Copying the summary word region
statement: Let $s\in\mathrm{Option}(\mathrm{Bool})$ and let $w$ be a Boolean word. At each integer cell $z$, assign the buffer content of $w$ shifted by two when $2\le z<2+|w|$, and otherwise use the summary-cell content for $s$ and the empty word. The resulting function equals the summary-cell function for $s$ and $w$.
